podcast.body: Featured on the *Mother's Milk* album, this song exemplifies Flea's slap-based style at its height. "The Chili Peppers and Higher Ground from Mother's Milk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This cover song became a big hit, played approximately a quarter of a million times on North American radio. Despite its popularity, the Red Hot Chili Peppers earned zero from its airplay in the United States because they were not the songwriters; all US royalties went to Stevie Wonder, the original songwriter. However, in Canada, they did receive payment due to neighboring rights and CMRRA fees. "Most of that airplay came in the United States where the chili peppers earned nothing for their efforts."
